speaker: rich
transcript:
Mike, listen carefully.

I just killed an infected man inside my house.

Asian. Shaved head. Biker jacket.

His neck was bent almost sideways when he came through the door.

That has to be your guy.

He didn’t wander here, either. He came straight for the house like he knew where the medicine was.

Mike, stop telling me it looks worse than it is.

How much blood did you lose?

Can you stand?

Do you need one of the antigen cartridges?

Tell me where you are and keep talking.

I mean it.

Do not go quiet on me.
summary: Rich connects the biker to Mike's scavenger and demands the truth about Mike's wound.
